title: When the Cipher Breaks
author: Edmund Kavanagh
blurb: Bram Marchetti, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
